properties.site-address: Lea Castle Hospital Park Gate Road
properties.notes: Outline planning application to include up to 600 dwellings (C3), up to 3,350sqm of Class B1 employment uses, 150sqm of Class A1/A3/D1 uses (local shop/café/community space), public open space, ecological mitigation, drainage works, infrastructure and ancillary works. Detailed approval is sought for access arrangements, to include the main access from Park Gate Road, secondary access from The Crescent and limited access to a small number of properties from Axborough Lane, with all other matters reserved. (REVISED / ADDITIONAL PLANS)
